title: Deterministic Pathfinding Runtime
objective: Ship deterministic tile/graph pathfinding for map/event movement and tactical positioning with diagnostics overlays.
scope: path request router for map/event runtime
editor diagnostics projection for path/cost/block reason
acceptance: identical inputs produce identical path output+cost
blocked path returns deterministic reason with no movement side-effects
diagnostics panel displays latest route nodes and cost
current_evidence: PathfindingGraph deterministic route and blocked-diagnostic tests
MapScene path request coverage in test_scene_manager.cpp
remaining_work: No standalone event_runtime pathfinding integration exists yet; event-source routing is represented through PathRequestSource::EventRuntime and MapScene tests only.

title: Dialogue Script Compiler + Roundtrip Export
objective: Enable text-first narrative authoring by compiling script text into message/event IR and exporting back to script.
acceptance: inspector can import/export script without data loss
completion_evidence: Dialogue script compiler builds deterministic dialogue pages and malformed-script diagnostics
Dialogue script exporter emits canonical roundtrip-stable text
MessageInspectorModel and MessageInspectorPanel expose import/export hooks

title: Behavior Tree Runtime for NPC/Battle AI
objective: Add deterministic behavior-tree execution for reactive battle and map AI.
scope: BT core nodes and runtime tick engine
acceptance: BT status transitions are deterministic under replay
battle AI can run via BT feature flag path
current_evidence: BehaviorBlackboard deterministic scalar and cooldown tests
BattleBehaviorTree bridge test covers feature-flag action queueing
remaining_work: No map/event-runtime behavior tree hook exists yet; current integration is battle-only.

title: Localization Extraction/Writeback + Lint Gate

acceptance: extraction output is canonical and stable
CI lint fails deterministically on missing/duplicate/invalid locale keys

title: Structured Telemetry and Crash Envelope Pipeline
objective: Unify diagnostics into structured telemetry envelopes for runtime/editor/compat failure triage.
gate_command: ctest --test-dir build/dev-ninja-debug -R "telemetry|crash_envelope|DiagnosticsFacade.*telemetry|failure diagnostics project to telemetry" --output-on-failure
acceptance: diagnostics facade emits deterministic telemetry envelope fields
compat severity tags map through telemetry projection correctly
telemetry sink can be disabled without changing runtime semantics
completion_evidence: TelemetrySink disabled mode preserves call success without storing events
DiagnosticsFacade emits deterministic telemetry envelope for snapshots
PluginManager exports compat failure diagnostics as telemetry JSONL via severityFromCompatTag
